title: Priyasakhi
desc: Sandhana Krishnan falls in love with Priya, a model. However, the couple strive to navigate challenges, as they come from contrasting families.

title: Ponn Vilangu
desc: Mallika falls in love with a police inspector, but when her older brother learns about it, he compels her to choose between her lover and himself.

title: Okariki Okaru
desc: Following a chance encounter at a railway station, two people fall in love with each other. However, after parting ways, they are determined to overcome the various obstacles in their path.

title: Thambikku Entha Ooru
desc: Seeing Balu's spendthrift and carefree attitude, his father sends him to his friend's house in a village to get reformed. Things get complicated when he gets entangled in a love triangle.
